answer: A sybil swarm stalls when each new agent must earn its place through the onyx-weight reputation vault. It locks 75 tokens in a vault that releases only after thirty days of clean trading, completes four supervised jobs while two established peers check receipts and delivery times, and carries a plume marker that fades if it misses a deadline, so buyers see trouble at a glance. Forging one identity costs about $840 in tokens, fees, and supervision, while 1,000 fakes need $840,000 and 6,000 hours of watched work. Like velvet that shows every crease, a record cannot hide a rushed forgery.
